scope: Insights listing (/insights), the Blogs post template (12 posts fetched, 5 read in full, 2 loaded in the browser at 1440x900 and 390x844), the 6 legal pages (/privacy-policy, /cookie-policy, /website-terms-of-use, /disclaimer, /accessibility-statement, /compliance-governance plus the 4 linked governance PDFs), and a site-wide compliance wording scan of all 25 sitemap URLs.
summary: The Insights listing and the post template look premium and consistent with the brand (cream, gold-rule cards, Boska italic titles) and the posts themselves are well written and uniquely titled and described, but the template underperforms the design: article text runs 1308 px wide at 16px (about 164 characters a line), there is no author, read time, related posts or working LinkedIn share, the Article schema has no dates, author or image, and no page on the site has an Open Graph image. Insights is the heaviest page audited at 12.4 MB on desktop because the hero stacks two full-bleed images and the card thumbnails are 1 to 1.5 MB PNGs served at 1600w. The most serious issues are legal: the Cookie Policy describes a consent banner and preference centre that do not exist while GA4 sets _ga cookies on first load of every page, the Privacy Policy is undated and gives no registered address, ICO number or named processors, and the Accessibility Statement claims contrast, labels and link text that axe measures as failing (26 contrast failures on Insights, unlabeled icon links, placeholder-only forms). The footer disclaimer is correct and present on all 25 URLs and the Compliance page and PDFs are consistent with it; the wording scan found no claim of FCA authorisation but 5 phrases that should change (an outcome promise with 'advice' on the Home page and 'approval chances' in the BTL guide) and about 20 clusters for compliance review (equity 'access' wording, 'private investment firm', contact FAQ timescales, the unverified partner claims and the unqualified 'buy-to-let mortgages' in the legal pages). A CodeSandbox-hosted script on Insights and About is a supply-chain risk that should be moved into Webflow.
strengths: Every one of the 12 posts has a unique, well-sized title (34 to 59 characters) and meta description (129 to 153 characters), a self-referencing canonical and Article JSON-LD from the template head code.

The footer regulatory disclaimer is present on all 25 URLs, correctly states that Roscap is not authorised or regulated by the FCA, and the Compliance and Governance page and its 4 PDFs repeat it consistently; the Complaints policy gives clear 3 and 15 business day service levels.
No console errors, page errors or 4xx responses on any page loaded; no horizontal scroll at 390 px; browser focus rings are not suppressed.
The 2026 posts (debt advisory, AI data centres, Manchester case study) are specific, well structured and link naturally to Track Record and Contact; the copy-link share control works.

The legal set is complete in scope (privacy, cookies, terms, disclaimer, accessibility, governance) and the Disclaimer covers no-offer, reliance, forward-looking statements and third-party introductions.
Card design on Insights is restrained and on-brand: whole card is the link, hover is subtle, grid collapses cleanly to one column on mobile.

findings.title: Cookie Policy describes a consent banner and preference centre that do not exist; GA4 cookies are set before any consent
findings.evidence: Playwright (Chromium, fresh context, no interaction) on /insights, 2 posts and all 6 legal pages: cookies present after load = _ga, _ga_H8HS2R6NLS (Google Analytics, .roscap.co.uk) and _cfuvid (Cloudflare). gtag.js (G-H8HS2R6NLS) is loaded in <head> with gtag('config') and no gtag('consent') call in any of the 25 fetched pages; no element matching cookie/consent/fs-cc selectors exists on any page. Cookie Policy text: 'Non-essential cookies are used only where you have provided consent via our cookie banner', 'Our cookie banner/preference centre provides the current cookie list, including provider, purpose, and duration', 'using the cookie preference link in the website footer (if enabled)'. The footer has no such link. Privacy Policy: technical data collected 'subject to your cookie preferences'. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/legal-cookie-policy-1440.png
findings.recommendation: Ship the approved in-house banner as a site-wide Symbol in the footer embed: Google Consent Mode v2 defaults (analytics_storage denied) set before gtag.js, gtag loads only after Accept, choice stored in localStorage, plus a 'Cookie preferences' text link in the footer Legal column that reopens it. Then rewrite the Cookie list section with the real cookies: _ga and _ga_H8HS2R6NLS (Google Analytics 4, analytics, 2 years), _cfuvid (Cloudflare, strictly necessary, session) and any Webflow form cookie; remove '(if enabled)'. Until the banner is live, the policy should not claim one exists.

findings.title: Privacy Policy is undated and missing controller details: no registered address, ICO number, named processors or retention periods; info@ email is a dead link
findings.evidence: Full read of /privacy-policy (900 words): no effective or last-updated date although the Changes section promises 'a revised effective date'; the only identifier is 'Roscap Limited (company number 13536901)'; grep of all 25 pages finds no postcode, no registered office address and no ICO registration number anywhere on the site; processors are described generically ('website hosting, IT support, CRM, analytics') while Google Analytics, Webflow (hosting and form submissions) and Cloudflare are observably in use; retention is 'as long as necessary' with no periods. In the rich text the email is wrapped as info@roscap.co.uk on /privacy-policy, /website-terms-of-use, /disclaimer and /accessibility-statement (legal_capture.json links array), so clicking it scrolls to top instead of opening mail. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/legal-privacy-policy-1440_part1.png
findings.recommendation: Add under the title: 'Last updated: [date]' and a Controller block with Roscap Limited, company number 13536901, registered office address, place of registration (England and Wales) and the ICO registration number (register if not yet done); the registered office address is also required on the website by the Companies (Trading Disclosures) Regulations 2015, so add it to the footer under the copyright line. Name the processors (Google Analytics 4, Webflow Inc. for hosting and form storage, Cloudflare) with a link to the Cookie Policy, give indicative retention periods (enquiries 24 months, transaction and KYC records 6 years), and change the four email links to href="mailto:info@roscap.co.uk".

findings.title: Accessibility Statement claims contrast, clear labels, link text and WCAG 2.1 AA that the pages do not meet
findings.evidence: Statement: 'Designing with sufficient colour contrast', 'Providing meaningful ... link text', 'ensuring form labels are clear', 'WCAG 2.1, Level AA, where reasonably practicable'; no date, no conformance status, no list of known issues. axe-core 4.x on /insights (1440 and 390) and /blogs/how-real-estate-debt-advisory-works-in-the-uk (1440 and 390): color-contrast serious, 26 nodes on Insights (card dates and excerpts #8d8d8d on #ffffff = 3.31:1 at 16px) and 3 on the post (date and footer lines #8d8d8d on #fffcf5 = 3.23:1, footer disclaimer at 14px); link-name serious 4 to 5 nodes (logo link .nav_brand-2, mailto/LinkedIn/Instagram icon links, mobile .nav_button-2 have no accessible name); input-button-name critical (footer newsletter <input type=submit value="">); landmark-one-main (no <main>). DOM: all 5 contact inputs and the newsletter input have placeholder only (no <label for>, no aria-label); share controls are 28x28 px <div>s without role or tabindex; in-article infographics have alt="". Lighthouse accessibility: insights 85, blog posts 83 to 86. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/legal-accessibility-statement-1440.png
findings.recommendation: Rewrite the statement on the W3C model: 'This website is partially conformant with WCAG 2.1 level AA', list the known issues (grey text contrast, icon links, form labels, share controls, infographic alt text, missing main landmark) with a target date, add 'Prepared [date], last reviewed [date]'. Fix the cheap ones in Webflow at the same time: change the .text-color-grey2 token from #8d8d8d to #6f6f6f (4.6:1 on cream), add aria-label to the logo and 3 social icon links and the mobile menu link, set the footer submit value to 'Subscribe' (or aria-label), wrap .main-wrapper in a <main> tag (Element settings > Tag), add visually hidden labels to the 6 inputs.

findings.title: Insights weighs 12.4 MB on desktop: a hidden second hero image, a 1.5 MB first-card thumbnail without srcset and 1 MB PNG card variants chosen by sizes=100vw
findings.evidence: Lighthouse (pre-run) insights-desktop total 12,389 KiB, mobile 3,649 KiB, mobile performance 62, LCP 6.5 s. Network: 6a86c43821b64fd77f76d895_Roscap Blog.png 1,556 KiB loaded twice (hero layer and first card thumbnail from the CMS copy 6a8c248c..._Roscap%2520Blog.png, which has no srcset so the full 1,556 KiB also loads on mobile); Financing Social Housing-p-1600.png 1,024 KiB, Financing AI Data Centres-p-1600.png 1,015 KiB, Property Portfolio Finance-p-1600.png 996 KiB, Development Exit Finance-p-1600.png 731 KiB, hotel 1,049 KiB, BTL 922 KiB. DOM: section.is-header contains two img.hero-bg both 1440x900, position absolute, z-index -1, opacity 1: the AVIF (daria-kraplak unsplash) underneath is fully covered by the PNG. Card thumbnails display at 582x349 px but carry sizes="100vw", so the browser picks the 1600w variant. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/insights-1440_part1.png
findings.recommendation: In the Insights header remove the PNG hero-bg layer and keep one image (re-export the typewriter photo as AVIF or WebP at 2000 px, under 250 KB). In the Blogs CMS re-upload the 12 thumbnails as WebP or AVIF at 1200 px wide (under 150 KB each) and replace the duplicated typewriter thumbnail on the debt advisory post. On the .blog-thumbnail element give the image a fixed width in Designer so Webflow writes sizes="(max-width: 767px) 100vw, 624px" (or set it manually in the element settings). Expected: desktop under 2.5 MB, mobile under 1.2 MB, LCP well under 4 s.

findings.title: Article body runs the full 1308 px container at 16px, about 164 characters per line; H2 and H3 share the same 40px size
findings.evidence: Computed styles on /blogs/uk-buy-to-let-mortgages-for-overseas-borrowers-using-a-company-structure at 1440: .w-richtext width 1308 px, max-width none, p 16px/24px Switzer rgb(40,40,40); estimated 164 characters per line (comfortable range 60 to 80). h2 40px/40px (line-height 1.0, margin-top 24px), h3 40px/48px, so sub-sections look like sections. The header summary paragraph also runs the full width. Mobile: p 16px/24px, h2 32px/32px. Same 1308 px measure on all 6 legal pages. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/post-debt-advisory-1440_part1.png
findings.recommendation: On the Blogs template set .bi-body-wrap (and the summary paragraph) to max-width 46rem (736 px), left-aligned under the title; body 18px/1.6 on desktop and 17px/1.55 below 768 px; H2 32px/1.2 with 40px top margin, H3 24px/1.3; keep figures full-container width via the existing .w-richtext-align-fullwidth class and keep the 64px Boska H1. Apply the same max-width to the Legal page rich text.

findings.page: /blogs/* (Blogs template head code and SEO settings)
findings.title: Article schema has no dates, author or image, and posts (and the whole site) have no Open Graph image
findings.evidence:
All 12 posts render Article JSON-LD with only @type, headline, description, url and publisher (example in blogs_how-real-estate-debt-advisory-works-in-the-uk.html); no datePublished, dateModified, author, image or mainEntityOfPage. Posts have no og:title, og:description, og:type or twitter tags; the 13 static pages have og:title/og:description/twitter:card but no og:image. The visible date is a plain
24 Aug 2026
with no . Canonicals are correct on all 25 URLs; titles are unique (34 to 59 characters) and descriptions 129 to 153 characters.
findings.recommendation: Blogs template head code: extend the JSON-LD with "datePublished": "{{Published On, ISO}}", "dateModified": "{{Updated On, ISO}}", "author": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Roscap"} (or the Teams reference once added), "image": "{{Thumbnail URL}}", "mainEntityOfPage": "{{canonical}}". In the template's SEO panel bind Open Graph title, description and image to Name, Summary and Thumbnail. In Site settings set a default 1200x630 OG image (cream background, gold R mark) for static pages. Wrap the visible date in <time datetime> via an embed.

findings.title: LinkedIn share button does nothing; both share controls are 28 px divs that keyboard users cannot reach
findings.evidence: The LinkedIn control is <div fs-socialshare-element="linkedin" class="bi-social-card"> but no Finsweet script is loaded (request log hosts: roscap.co.uk, website-files.com, googletagmanager.com, cloudfront.net, analytics.google.com, doubleclick.net). Playwright click on it: 0 popups, 0 navigations. The copy-link control works via an inline clipboard script. Both are 28x28 px <div>s with no role, tabindex or aria-label (checks_out.json share array). Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/post-debt-advisory-1440_part1.png
findings.recommendation: Replace the LinkedIn div with a Link Block: href https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url={{current page URL via embed}}, target _blank, rel noopener, aria-label 'Share on LinkedIn'. Convert the copy control to a <button aria-label="Copy link"> (embed) and keep the 'Copied' toast. Give both a 40x40 px hit area while keeping the 18 px icons.

findings.title: Key facts are published as text inside PNG infographics with empty alt text; illegible on mobile and one contains the typo 'Deport Required'
findings.evidence: BTL post: 6 in-article (Why the UK Attracts..., Benefits of Using a Company (SPV) Structure, SIC Codes, Key Lending Criteria at a Glance, The Mortgage Process..., Challenges...) all alt="", 1370x600 PNG, no srcset; figure style="max-width:1370pxpx" (invalid unit). At 390 px the text inside renders at roughly 5 to 7 px (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/post-btl-overseas-390_part6.png). The 'Key Lending Criteria' graphic reads 'Deport Required' (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/post-btl-overseas-1440_part3.png). Hotel post caption 'Why Investors are draws to UK hotel assets' and heading 'Key Performance Metrics Leaders Analyse' (should be Lenders). The same facts already appear in the body text.
findings.recommendation: Remove the duplicated infographics or rebuild the two tabular ones (SIC codes, lending criteria) as native rich-text tables; where an image stays, write a descriptive alt (for example 'Four lending criteria: 25 to 40 percent deposit, 125 to 145 percent rental cover, personal guarantees, credit and AML checks'). Correct 'Deport' to 'Deposit', 'draws' to 'drawn', 'Leaders' to 'Lenders'.

findings.title: Copy defects in the two long guides: duplicated intro, spacing typos, pseudo-bullets, two H1s and inconsistent brand casing
findings.evidence:
Summary paragraph repeated verbatim as the first body paragraph on both posts (summaryDuplicated true); 'isa limited company', 'indicate show much', 'through anSPV company', 'company-ownedBuy-to-Let'; bullets are '●' characters inside

(39 pseudo-bullets, 0

    in the BTL post) so screen readers do not announce lists and indents vary; 5 empty paragraphs (zero-width joiner) leave uneven gaps; 'FAQs' is a second

    on both posts (Lighthouse heading-order fails on the mobile run); brand written 'ROSCAP' in these posts but 'Roscap' everywhere else; em dashes in 2 excerpts on the listing.
findings.recommendation: Edit the two CMS items: delete the duplicate first paragraph, convert ● paragraphs to real bulleted lists, fix the 4 spacing errors, demote FAQs to H2, use 'Roscap', remove empty paragraphs, and replace em dashes with commas or full stops. 30 minutes of editing, no template change.

findings.title: Listing has no way to scan by topic and the mobile hero pushes every card below the fold
findings.evidence: 12 .w-dyn-item cards in a 2x6 grid (624 px columns), no category or tag field, no featured or latest marker, no filter or search (0 matching elements), dates 16px #8d8d8d (3.31:1), excerpt same grey. Mobile (390x844): the hero (h1 40px plus two paragraphs over the photo) ends at about 705 CSS px, so no card content is visible on first paint (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/insights-390_part1.png). The 12 dates run 01 Oct 2025, 01 Nov 2025 ... 01 Aug 2026 then 24 Aug 2026, which reads as back-filled scheduling. Pagination is not needed at 12 items.
findings.recommendation: Add an Option field 'Category' (Guides, Case studies, Market views) to the Blogs collection and show it as a small gold uppercase label above the card title; render the newest item as a full-width featured card at the top (Collection List limited to 1, second list offset 1); cap the mobile hero at 55vh; darken date and excerpt to #6f6f6f. Keep a single page, no pagination, and do not add posts for the sake of volume.

findings.title: No author, read time or related posts; the only in-article conversion path is a 5-field placeholder-only form
findings.evidence: Template renders date, share icons, H1, summary, thumbnail, rich text, then the contact banner (form wf-form-Contact-Form: name, email, Phone, Subject, Message, all placeholder-only) and the footer. DOM checks: author/byline elements 0, related or collection lists 0, no 'Back to Insights' except nav and footer, no read time. Teams CMS collection exists. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/post-debt-advisory-1440_part2.png
findings.recommendation: Add a Reference field 'Author' (Teams) to Blogs and render name, role and 40 px photo under the title with the date; compute read time in the template script (word count / 200) and show it next to the date; add a 'Related insights' Collection List (3 items, same Category, exclude current) above the footer; replace the full form with a one-line close ('Discuss a requirement in confidence') and a 'Speak to Us' button to /contact-us, keeping one form on the contact page. If the form stays, add visible labels.

findings.title: Wording scan: 5 phrases that should change and about 20 clusters for compliance review; footer disclaimer correct on every page
findings.evidence: Text of all 25 sitemap URLs scanned for FCA, regulated, authorised, advice, adviser, advisor, advisory, guarantee, best, lowest, approved, mortgage, secure, recurring revenue, returns, IRR, risk-free, competitive, fast, as little as, within, hundreds, in perpetuity: 204 body hits (147 fine, 52 review, 5 change), full table in data. Should change: Home 'our team provides advice shaped by current conditions, ensuring every client and project secures the most appropriate form of capital' (advice plus outcome promise); BTL post 'Higher deposits ... improve mortgage approval chances'. Review: Home 'capital advisory and private investment firm'; Our Services 'Roscap provides access to: Preferred Equity, Fixed-return positions behind senior debt' (equity offered to investors); hotel post 'attractive returns'; contact FAQ 'as little as 5-10 working days', 'within 6-8 weeks', 'competitive terms'; partner program 'hundreds of current partners', 'commissions in perpetuity', 'recurring revenue stream with minimal work' (unverified); Privacy, Terms and Disclaimer list 'buy-to-let mortgages' among unregulated activities without qualifying the borrower; Track Record '12% IRR', '14% IRR'. No page claims FCA authorisation; the footer disclaimer appears on all 25 URLs.
findings.recommendation: Items for review, not legal advice. Change the Home sentence to 'our team arranges capital shaped by current conditions, so each client and project is matched with the most appropriate form of capital'; change the BTL line to 'lenders generally view higher deposits more favourably'. Ask compliance to confirm: 'private investment firm' (or use 'capital advisory and arrangement firm'), the equity wording on Our Services, the BTL article scope (add 'This guide covers unregulated buy-to-let lending to limited companies and professional landlords; it is general information, not advice'), the contact timescales (keep the 'subject to' caveats), and add 'unregulated' before 'buy-to-let mortgages' on the three legal pages. Resolve the partner program claims with Clemente before any redesign.

findings.title: A script is loaded from a CodeSandbox preview URL (jj59l3.csb.app), a third-party sandbox outside Roscap's control
findings.evidence: Both pages include <script src="https://jj59l3.csb.app/script.js"> (1,486 bytes: GSAP counter for .stats-cards-wrap and Swiper init for .slider-wrap). CodeSandbox preview hosts are editable by whoever owns the sandbox, carry no SRI hash and can disappear. On /insights neither .stats-cards-wrap nor .slider-wrap exists, so it runs for nothing while Swiper 12 (32 KB unused per Lighthouse) is also loaded there.
findings.recommendation: Paste the 1.5 KB script into Webflow page custom code (before </body>) on About only, delete the csb.app tag and the Swiper tag from Insights, and check Home and other pages for the same host.

findings.title: Legal pages have no H1 and no dates; section headings are bold paragraphs and three pages contain an empty heading
findings.evidence:
Each page's title is an

inside the rich text (h1 count 0 on all 6); /cookie-policy, /website-terms-of-use and /disclaimer also contain

‍

(zero-width joiner); section labels are inside

; no 'last updated' date on any of the 6 pages (date grep returned nothing except the copyright year); body 16px/24px across 1308 px. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/legal-disclaimer-1440.png
findings.recommendation: Make the page title an H1 (heading-style-h1), convert the bold labels to H2, delete the empty headings, add 'Last updated: [date]' under each title, constrain the rich text to 46rem. A small Legal CMS collection (title, body, last updated) would keep the 6 pages consistent.

findings.title: Regulatory statements are consistent with the footer but phrased 3 different ways; governance PDFs are undated and one filename has a typo
findings.evidence: Footer: 'not authorised or regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority ... not covered by the FSCS or the FOS'. Compliance page: 'not authorised or regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority' (consistent). Disclaimer: 'Roscap is not regulated, and services are not covered by any financial services compensation schemes' (different phrasing, drops FOS). The 4 PDFs (Complaints Handling, Conflicts of Interest, AML/KYC, Anti-Bribery) return 200 and repeat the FCA/FOS/FSCS exclusion, but have no version or date; file is named 'Complaints Handing Policy.pdf'; cards give no PDF hint. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/legal-compliance-governance-1440.png
findings.recommendation: Adopt the footer sentence as the canonical regulatory statement in the Disclaimer and the PDFs; add 'Version 1.0, [date]' to each PDF, re-upload the complaints file with the corrected name, and add '(PDF)' to the four card labels.

findings.title: Contact forms on Insights and every post complete inline, so these leads may never reach the /contact-us-success key event
findings.evidence: Form tag on the template: <form id="wf-form-Contact-Form" method="get" ...> with no data-redirect attribute, action = the current page URL (Webflow default), success shown inline ('Thank you! Your submission has been received!'). The CONTEXT notes the GA4 generate_lead key event and Google Ads landing on /contact-us; if generate_lead is defined on the success page view, submissions from 13 URLs are uncounted.
findings.recommendation: Set the form's Redirect URL to /contact-us-success in Form settings on the Blogs template and Insights page, or fire gtag('event','generate_lead') on the Webflow form success element (.w-form-done becoming visible) in site code. Confirm with whoever owns analytics.

findings.title: First card repeats the hero photograph and uses a generic alt; other thumbnails have empty alt
findings.evidence: At 1440 the typewriter photo fills the hero and appears again as the first card image directly beneath (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal/insights-1440_part1.png); its alt is 'Roscap insights', all other card thumbnails alt="". The listing also has no visible 'Latest' cue.
findings.recommendation: Give the debt advisory post its own thumbnail (or use a different hero photo), and bind the thumbnail alt to a CMS 'Image description' field or set it to decorative consistently since the card title is the link text.

opportunities.title: Contents list for long guides
opportunities.description: The BTL and hotel guides have 9 H2 and 20 H3 headings over 2,000 words. A small 'Contents' list (links to H2 anchors) under the summary, rendered by a 20-line script only when a post has more than 6 H2s, helps scanning without changing the template's look.

opportunities.title: Deal facts panel on case study posts
opportunities.description: Case studies could reuse the Track Record card style for a compact facts panel (Amount, Product, LTV, Lender, Term, Location) driven by optional CMS fields; shown only when the Category is Case study. Ties Insights to the approved Track Record module.

opportunities.title: Privacy line under the newsletter form
opportunities.description: The 'Sign up for new alerts' form has no privacy notice. Add one line: 'By subscribing you agree to our Privacy Policy. Unsubscribe at any time.' and name the email tool in the Privacy Policy once chosen.

opportunities.title: Legal CMS collection with last-updated dates
opportunities.description: Six static legal pages are maintained by hand with different heading markup. A Legal collection (title, body, last updated, version) and one template gives a consistent H1, date line and reading width, and makes dated versions easy to keep for ICO or counterparty due diligence.

opportunities.title: Reduced-motion check for header animation
opportunities.description: The Insights header uses Webflow IX2 opacity and transform animations (inline style on section.is-header). Add a site-wide @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rule that sets .section[style] transitions to none, so the listing appears immediately for users who opt out of motion.

data:
# Insights and legal audit: data and inventories

Not legal advice: compliance items are framed for review by Roscap's compliance adviser.

## Method and assumptions
- Live site fetched 31 Oct 2026 with curl (all 25 sitemap URLs, HTTP 200) and Playwright Chromium (Insights and 2 posts at 1440x900 and 390x844 mobile emulation; 6 legal pages at 1440x900). Full-page screenshots in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/shots/insights-legal. axe-core run on /insights and /blogs/how-real-estate-debt-advisory-works-in-the-uk at both sizes. Lighthouse figures are from the pre-run JSON in scratchpad/lh (not re-run).
- Working files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-sonar/6b47e843-950d-5a6c-8dda-ec854c8993c6/scratchpad/work/insights-legal (html/, text/, _meta.json, capture.json, legal_capture.json, checks_out.json, compliance_hits.json, compliance_classified.json, compliance_table.md, pdfs/).
- Only failed request on every page load: analytics.google.com/g/collect (net::ERR_ABORTED, the sandbox blocks GA beacons). No console errors, no page errors, no 4xx on any page loaded.
- Forms were inspected in markup only; nothing was submitted. The LinkedIn share control was clicked (it is not a form) to verify behaviour.
- Dates: the 12 posts are dated 01 Oct 2025 to 01 Aug 2026 on the 1st of each month plus 24 Aug 2026; treated as published dates as shown.

## Page inventory (head metadata)
| URL | Title (chars) | Description (chars) | og:title/desc | og:image | JSON-LD | H1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
